notes.title: Patch 0.2.5.2
notes.notes:
1)  New option to skip songs and restart songs during workouts.
	• From the pause screen, players are now able to restart the song they are currently playing, or skip the current song.
2) Added option to auto download missing songs
3) Bug Fixes:
	• Fixed bug causing an error to be thrown when a playlist fails to be read correctly.
	• Fixed bug causing an error to be thrown when a download fails.
	• Fixed bug causing choreography to sometimes stay on one side for an extended period of time.
	• Fixed bug causing targets to sometimes appear too late to be hit before the end of the song breaking streaks.
	• Fixed bug causing choreography to sometimes allow directional targets to be on the same side in a row.
	• When in passthrough in menu, the environment now completely disappears.
	• Started improving main menu performance.
	• Fixed bug causing playlist scores to affect individual song scores.
	• Fixed bug causing target hit and miss effects to be unaffected by changing sfx volume setting.
	• Fixed bug causing an error to be thrown when failing to play a song preview.
	• Fixed bug causing an error to be thrown when failing to download or convert a song.

notes.title: Patch 2.4
notes.notes:
1) Improved song sorting and filtering.
	• Song sorting is now persistent between sessions.
	• Songs can now be filtered by built in, custom, and more.

2) Added a new Arm Length Calibration setting.
	• Players can now re-calibrate their arm length to ensure better striking range. This can be done in player settings.

3) Anti-aliasing is now enabled for Quest 3 and PCVR. It can be enabled or disabled in Gameplay Settings.

4) Added a new option to disable targets from appearing at the same time as obstacles. By default they will still show up for hard and expert maps. But can be disabled under Gameplay Settings.

5) Bug Fixes:
	• Fixed bug causing an error to be thrown sometimes when returning to menu with active targets or objects.
	• Fixed bug causing an error to sometimes be thrown when updating user profiles.
	• Fixed bug causing an error to be thrown when a playlist item fails to load.
	• Fixed bug causing an error to be thrown sometimes when trying to validate a playlist.
	• Fixed bug causing an error to be thrown when a song does not have any difficulty information.
	• Fixed bug causing calibrating arm length to cause errors to be thrown after completing and squeezing grips.
	• Fixed bug causing an error to sometimes be thrown when completing a download.
	• Fixed bug causing arm calibration to fail when only calibrating your right hand.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
1) Bug Fixes:
	• Fixed multiple bugs causing errors to sometimes be thrown when converting local mp3s.
	• Improved handling of BeatSage responding slowly after song conversion completed.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.2.2.01
notes.notes:
Fixed bug causing profile creation to fail.

Please not, if you were affected by this issue, we recommend deleting any profiles created during the most recent update in order to prevent possible issues in gameplay.

notes.title: Patch V0.2.2
notes.notes:
1) Improved conversion of local mp3s
	• Songs converted in game will now show their correct BPM.
	• Targets will now be more closely timed to the correct BMP.
	• Improved consistency of different levels.
	• Improved rotation event consistency and obstacle consistency.

2) Bug Fixes:
	• Improved transition performance from main menu to gameplay reducing frame loss.
	• Fixed bug causing some songs to not properly import causing  a warning to display stating they are missing difficulty options.
	• Improved overall settings performance and improved stability and added protections against corrupting data.
	• Detecting corrupted accounts now implemented and instructs players to delete their account if it is corrupted.

notes.title: Patch 0.2.1.1
notes.notes:
1) New option to hide built in songs and playlists!
	• Built in songs and playlists can now be individually hidden. They can be unhidden in the settings menu under Player Settings.

2) Bug Fixes:
	• Fixed bug causing songs to resume from paused immediately despite displaying countdown sometimes.
	• Fixed bug causing easy and normal difficulty on jabs only to force every obstacle to include duplicate targets with every obstacle sometimes.
	• Fixed bug deleting a playlist to sometimes throw an error.
	• Fixed bug causing the home page to not update after songs are downloaded.
	• Fixed bug causing workouts with missing songs to be playable resulting in errors being thrown.
	• Fixed bug causing notifications to stack and not pull the next notification correctly resulting in unexpected function.
	• Fixed bug causing playlists to sometimes not delete after confirming to delete them.
	• Scroll arrows on home screen are now not visible unless useable.
	• Fixed bug causing an error to be thrown when trying to access the auto-generate maps folder.
	• Fixed bug causing an error to be thrown upon load sometimes.
	• Fixed wording in the Help menu.
	• Fixed wording in the About menu.
	• Fixed bug causing selecting the same tab in the Options menu to reset the displayed options.
	• Added a "Revert" button to allow you to undo changes you've made in the settings menu.
	• Fixed bug causing a random floating box sometimes to appear in the settings menu.

notes.title: Version 0.2
notes.notes:
1) All new original songs! New songs include:
	• Against The Tide
	• Cabaret Carnival
	• Champions Creed
	• Chasing The Weekend
	• Circuit Board Queen
	• Cuchulainn
	• Digital Odyssey
	• Echoes In The Dark
	• Finding Hope
	• Ignite The Night
	• Midnight Masquerade
	• Neon Horizon
	• Rebels With A Cause
	• Redemption
	• Relevant
	• Ride From The Ashes
	• Rise Up
	• Ritzy Rendezvous
	• Shadow BoXR
	• Swingin Through Time
	• Symphony Of The Seas
	• The Awakening
	• Thors Journey
	• Watch Me Rise
	• Wild And Free

2) Added two new Game Mode overrides! Target Speed Mod and Song Speed Mod! Like the other settings in this window, it is a saved setting and will be saved to your playlists and your default settings when playing a single song.
	• Target Speed Mod: Players can now add a modifier to the speed of the targets. 
	• Song Speed Mod: Players can now add a modifier to the speed of the actual song changing the song length, pitch, and BPM. 

3) Choreography Improvements.
	• If the difficulty is set to Easy or Normal, targets will no longer appear under obstacles. They will still appear sometimes appear under obstacles in Hard and Expert difficulties.
	• Obstacles will appear a little more frequently now.

4) Improved Timing Display:
	• New and improved timing display added to targets to help guide your timing! The timing display can be enable or disabled in the Player Settings tab of the settings menu.

5) Bug Fixes:
	• Fixed bug causing an error to be thrown sometimes when returning to main menu before a song completes.
	• Fixed bug causing targets to appear inside of obstacles sometimes when in Jabs only mode.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.1.39.1
notes.notes:
1) Fixed bug causing end of song information to not display after playing at least once.

Note: The current built in songs will be removed in an upcoming update.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.39
notes.notes:
1) General Choreography flow improvements
2) Improved Main Menu and Simulator Deck environment.
3) Bug Fixes:
	• Fixed bug causing custom songs converted in game to throw an error due to an unexpected update from third party service.
	• Fixed bug causing an error to be thrown sometimes when returning to main menu before a song completes.
	• Fixed bug causing hook targets to appear sometimes when players selected Jabs Only mode.
	• Fixed bug causing notifications to overlap if more than one is requested.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.1.38.2
notes.notes: Fixed bug causing auto convert songs to throw an error.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.38.1
notes.notes:
1) Environment and game mode settings now persistent!
	• The following settings are now persistent: 
		-Default Environment
		-Default Forward Foot
		-One Handed Override
		-No Obstacles Override
		-Jabs Only Override
		-Default Game Mode
		-Default Difficulty
		-Default Game Mode
		-Gloves Environment Override (Connected to each environment)
		-Targets Environment Override (Connected to each environment)
		-Obstacles Environment Override (Connected to each environment)

2) Bug Fixes:
	• Fixed bug causing an error to be thrown when returning to the main menu when targets or obstacles are active in game sometimes.
	• Fixed bug that could cause instability when selecting some songs in community content.
	• Fixed bug that could cause the game to lock up completely after downloading a community content song with insufficient or incomplete data.
        • Fixed bug causing selecting some text fields to be unreliable.
	• Fixed bug that could cause songs containing illegal characters in their name to fail to be read.
	• Fixed bug causing resuming gameplay from settings to result in unexpected results.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.37
notes.notes:
1) Improved easy, and normal difficulty automatically generated songs.
2) New boxing environment "Boxing Ring".
3) Bug Fixes:
	• Fixed bug causing mp3s without file information to cause the local mp3 converting to break.
	• Updated serialization system to improve settings and data saving.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.36.3
notes.notes:
1) Added option to set default environment in player settings
2) Added count down timer after resuming gameplay.
3) Added an auto convert local songs folder named "ShadowBoXR-Songs" to files for easier converting of local songs. This is found at the root of your device or game installation location.
4) Bug Fixes:
	• Fixed multiple bugs causing errors to be thrown sometimes when navigating community content.
	• Fixed bug causing re-downloading a song to throw errors.
	• Fixed bug causing an error to be thrown when trying to search your device for custom songs.
	• Fixed bug causing some saved data to corrupt and throw an error.
	• Fixed bug causing available local MP3s to not display their name correctly sometimes.
	• Fixed bug causing the loading displays to sometimes throw an error when activated too quickly.
	• Fixed bug causing invalid game modes to display as an option causing further bugs when selected.
	• Fixed bug causing songs converted from MP3s to incorrectly compare to other songs resulting in unexpected results such as removing the wrong song from a playlist.
	• Fixed bug causing an error to be thrown when trying to determine players scores for a playlist sometimes.
	• Fixed bug causing some targets and obstacles to appear too closely together at the beginning of a song sometimes.
	• Fixed bug causing some users to experience songs not showing as available on the Convert Local Mp3s page.
	• Fixed bug causing an error to occur when trying to download custom songs.
	• Fixed bug causing songs to throw errors when containing certain special characters.
	• Fixed bug causing the in game timer to pause and not resume after pausing the game.
	• Fixed bug causing a three second delay when returning back to main menu.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.36.1
notes.notes:
1) Added option to set default environment in player settings

3) Bug Fixes:
	• Fixed bug causing available local MP3s to not display their name correcly sometimes.
	• Fixed bug causing the loading displays to sometimes throw an error when activated too quickly.
	• Fixed bug causing invalid game modes to display as an option causing further bugs when selected.
	• Fixed bug causing songs converted from MP3s to incorrectly compare to other songs resulting in unexpected results such as removing the wrong song from a playlist.
	• Fixed bug causing an error to be thrown when trying to determine players scores for a playlist sometimes.
	• Fixed bug causing some targets and obstacles to appear too closely together at the beginning of a song sometimes.
	• Fixed bug causing some users to experience songs not showing as available on the Convert Local Mp3s page.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.36
notes.notes:
1) Reworked creating and editing playlists!
	• Re-ordered panels to improve editing and creating workflow. Panels are now, from left to right, Available Songs, Songs in Playlist, and Playlist Settings.
	• Moved customizing individual songs to the Songs in Playlists. Players can now just add the songs and then edit what has been added.
	• Added option to preview a song by selecting the play button for each song on Available Songs.
	• Playlists can now be re-ordered by clicking and dragging the song you want to edit.

2) Mp3 files stored in your downloads folder can now be automatically converted into Shadow BoXR supported songs.
	• The current implementation is powered by BeatSage and does require an active internet connection. This is primarily to improve in game performance and allow song conversion without interrupting gameplay.

3) More flow improvements!
	• Improved algorithm and changed how targets after a duck obstacle are handled.

4) Bug Fixes:
	• Fixed bug causing viewing next page in community content to throw an error sometimes.
	• Fixed bug causing previewing community content song to throw an error sometimes.
	• Improved error reporting to give more detailed information.
	• Fixed bug causing community content search page to not work correctly sometimes.
	• Fixed bug causing some built in songs to throw an error when playing one handed mode.
	• Fixed bug causing community content search page to not work correctly sometimes.
	• Fixed bug previewing a custom song to sometimes throw an error.
	• Fixed bug causing some custom songs to fail to save due to "illegal" characters.
	• Temporarily disabled images in custom songs to fix a bug causing loading custom songs to sometimes get stuck.
	• Fixed bug causing sound settings and target FPS to revert to their default values upon startup.
	• Fixed bug causing the playlist maker tool to return an error sometimes when saving an empty list or causing it to say changes have been made when the list is empty.
	• Fixed bug causing community songs to sometimes throw an error when attempting to download a community song.
	• Fixed bug causing environment and game mode overrides to reset when playing a single song.
	• Fixed bug causing songs being previewed in the workout editing menu to continue to play after closing or moving to a different menu.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.34.1
notes.notes:
1) Bug Fixes:
	• Fixed bug causing YUR watch to throw an error at the beginning of gameplay sometimes.
	• Set community content songs search field to only update once the full text has been entered and player selects to close the keyboard to reduce unnecessary bandwith use and improve performance and stability.
	• Fixed bug causing Shadow BoXR to fail to track if the game is in focus or not correctly.
	• Fixed bug causing community content songs to sometimes throw an error when trying to preview a song.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.34
notes.notes:
1)  Re-worked beatmaping algorithm to ensure a better flow and balanced workout. 
	• Directional targets will now always appear on the side opposite of the previous target allowing more fluid movement. 
	• Decreased maximum number of targest allowed on the same side ensuring both sides get a great workout!

2) Player stance now changes during songs!
	• Whenever a song is at least 1.55 minutes long, stance change events will occur.
	• Stance change events currently occur once every minute.
	• When a stance change event fires, the choreography will pause for 5 seconds during which time it will show the stance change indicator. 

3) Bug Fixes:
	• Improved handing of cancelled delayed events preventing errors to be logged with it is already being handled.
	• Fixed issue causing custom songs page to sometimes throw an error when trying to scroll due to a cancelled token.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.33.3
notes.notes:
1) Bug Fixes:
	• Fixed bug causing creating a playlist to fail when including the built in songs "Dance" or "Sky".
	• Fixed bug causing players to have to sign in to YUR every time they opened the game.
	• Fixed bug causing retrieving settings to sometimes break due to corrupted data.
	• Added an internal "Legacy" configuration for beat maps to fix a bug causing an error to be thrown when retrieving some custom songs.
	• Improved handling of errors when downloading songs fails. If connections time out, players will be given an option to try again.
	• Fixed bug causing "Latest" in community songs to not account for user search input.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.33.2
notes.notes:
1) Bug Fixes:
	• Fixed issue causing incomplete error logging
	• Fixed issue causing incorrectly saved data to break the game.
	• Improved YUR watch stability.
	• Fixed bug causing glove, target, and obstacle names to not display in some custom environments.
	• Fixed issue allowing players to edit the current environment when there isnt one set resulting in errors being thrown.

2) User experience improvements.
	• Added Song score display. Currently this only works on songs downloaded  this update or later however re-downloading existing songs will update them.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.33
notes.notes:
1)  New stance option "Horsefoot". This option prompts a straight on pose. This allows dodge obstacles to appear on either side

2) Bug Fixes:
	• Fixed issue causing pop ups to require selecting an option to close them.
	• Fixed issue causing playlists to not play delete correctly sometimes.

3) User experience improvements.
	• Beats per minute now displayed in song information.
	• Added "Resume button to settings menu in game.
	• Height calibration is now more straightforward.
	• Overall UI improvements

notes.title: Patch 0.1.32.1
notes.notes:
1)  Game mode overrides! Under the Game Mode Overrides section you can now disable obstacles, force jabs only, or force one handed mode.

2) Bug Fixes:
	• Fixed issue causing the game to sometimes crash when trying to view a playlist. (Note Custom Environments and Workouts will need to have their environment overrides re-set. Unfortunately this system required a rework and is incompatible with previous versions.)
	• Fixed issue preventing playlist records from being displayed.
	• Fixed issue sometimes causing custom environments to cause the game to fail to load.
	• Fixed issue causing the black fog of profile selection to always be active or to activate when returning from a workout.
	• Removed unnecessary webcalls to reduce data usage.
	•Fixed bug causing the game to get into a locked state requiring players to restart the game when selecting a playlist created prior to version 0.1.32 using a custom environment created prior to 0.1.32. This was caused by an oversight in attempting to load the previous data resulting in unexpected results.

3) User experience improvements.
	• Improved play button visuals and visibility.
	• Confirmation now requested when deleting playlists.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.31
notes.notes:
1) Gloves, targets, and obstacles are no longer locked per environment and custom sets can be set when creating a custom environment, playlist, or just selecting individual songs.

2) Bug Fixes:
	• Fixed issue sometimes requiring both pointers to be pointed at a scroll view in order to scroll via joysticks.
	• Fixed issue causing profile options to randomize every time.

3) User experience improvements.
	• If player only has one profile, it is now automatically selected to streamline user experience.
	• Player is greeted on home screen now and given the option to change their profile by selecting their icon.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.30
notes.notes:
1) Players can now opt in to participate in online leaderboards that will record their best score. Each leaderboard is specific to a specific song, in a specific game mode, at a specific difficulty just like local leaderboards.

2) Bug Fixes:
• Fixed issue causing some devices to not work
• Fixed issue causing profiles to sometimes create duplicates

notes.title: Patch 0.1.29
notes.notes:
1) Players can now create custom environments with custom skyboxes. Currently this is limited to only custom skyboxes. Currently custom skyboxes are limited to .Png, .Jpg, .Jpeg, and .hdr pictures.  Create new environments under custom content. Images are searched for in the downloads folder. Simply download the image you want and select to add new skyboxes!

2) Community content loading screen improved. Now simply disables the view and does not block interactions with the listen, download, or home buttons

3) Players can now play songs directly after downloading them from the same page as well delete them.

4) A song progress display now shows players the progress of the active song using a background that fills as it progresses.

5) Bug Fixes:
	•Custom backgrounds are now able to load from the quick play home screen play button.
	•Selecting or changing forward foot works correctly when selected from playlists now.
	•Fixed bug causing the main menu to show the dark shadow when returning from gameplay.
	•Dark waters visual improvements.
	•Improved SteamVR support.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.27
notes.notes: New Dark Waters Environment

notes.title: Patch 0.1.26.1
notes.notes:
1) Improved performance in main menu.

2) Added option to listen to each song under the All Songs page. Once selected, a song will automatically start playing after 2.5 seconds. It can be stopped or restarted by selecting the "Listen"/"Stop" button found next to the play button.

3) Added two new songs!
	• Dance by Luke Bergs (Jazz)
	• Sky (feat. Matty M.) by DEgITx (Elecrto-Metal)

4) Improved creating and updating playlist workflow. If players select home button after making changes they will be prompted to save before returning.
	• Updating a playlist will no longer create duplicate playlist.
	• When playlists are updated, they maintain their sorted position.

5) Bug fixes.
	•  Fixed bug causing memory leak and loss of performance when returning from game back to main menu.

	• Fixed bug causing community content songs to randomly stop downloading and becoming unavailable to download. 

	• Songs will no longer randomly stop and if internet connection is lost or a download fails, it will remove it from the active downloads list and allow you to try again.

	• Song previews stop loading when returning to main menu.

	• Fixed issue causing an error to be thrown when deleting a playlist from the view playlist page.

	• Improved custom song support to support songs that by default do not have a normal mode but do have a one handed mode. This removes infinite loading screen after downloading them.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.24
notes.notes:
1)  Started implementing player statistics tracking. Total number of hit targets, their hit quality, and dodged obstacles is now recorded in player profile for future use in achievements.

2) Improved obstacle visuals. 
	• Added visual feedback to getting hit by obstacles. The screen will now flash the color of the obstacle when your head collides with obstacles.
	• Space arena obstacles now have transparency.

3) Improved audio settings by changing how it is mixed and controlled. 
	•Menu music and menu sound effects are now controlled completely separately from game music and game sound effects. 
	•Sound effects now duck music considerably more to ensure they can be heard even during loud points in game music.

4) Adaptive Strike Mode! Enabling this setting will cause the difficulty to strike targets to adapt to you! As you strike harder, the difficulty required to hit targets will grow based on your average strike speed. If it gets too hard, don't worry keep punching the targets and the average difficulty will slowly decrease to match your new average speed.

5) Player strike speed and average speed are now displayed using a small bar above the current score display while working out.

6) Improved head detection for better experience dodging obstacles.
	•Head collider has been moved down slightly and the radius has been decreased.

7) Bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.22
notes.notes:
1) Super Strike Targets! Some targets will now appear with an additional glow around them. In order to successfully hit them, players are required to strike the targets with much more force. This will help add some additional variance, keep players on their toes, and help improve the workout!

2) Added descriptions to Target Side Mode settings during profile editing.

3) Bug fixes and improvements. 
	• Fixed bug causing targets to sometimes get re-pooled prematurely resulting in a registered miss.
	• Fixed bug causing some songs to not give the option to select target difficulty.
	• Improved feel for striking hooks and uppercuts. Increased collider size slightly resulting in improved hit detection.
	• Dodge obstacles now require more movement. They are slightly closer to the middle resulting in requiring the player to move out of the way more.
	• Targets appearing during a dodge obstacle will be forced to the opposing hand for a more natural experience.
4) Menu music and sound effects can be changed independently of in game music and sound effects from the settings menu now.

5) Game updates can now be viewed in game. 
	• Players are notified upon first time playing after updating and can view all updates under the help menu under "Updates".

notes.title: Hotfix 0.1.20.1
notes.notes: Fixed issue causing creating custom workouts to add duplicate and remove duplicate songs.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.20
notes.notes:
Fixed bug causing community content to display the wrong thumbnail when scrolling.

Players are now able to set desired Target Side Mode during profile creation. 

Existing profiles that have not set Target Side Mode are now prompted to upon selection.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.19
notes.notes:
Fixed bug causing keyboard to type each letter twice.

Community content now is an endless scroller instead of having individual pages.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.18
notes.notes:
Improved performance.

Player can select starting forward foot now.

Improved user experience when returning from a workout.

Scrollable lists can now be dragged.

Index Controllers should now be able to pause the game and return to the menu by pressing the B button.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.17
notes.notes:
Fixed issue that occasionally caused all custom songs to be deleted when deleting one song.

Improved haptics based on hit quality and power.

Hit VFX are now affected by hit quality and power to further show how well the player is doing with each note.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.16
notes.notes:
Fixed bug causing some songs/difficulties to fail to load their choreography.

Improved haptic feedback to be based on user hit quality and power.
